description:
First phase of bl-7c23. Standalone — does not touch branch or step shape, so the prompt path keeps working throughout this ball.

=== Scope ===

1. Introduce LERNIE_HOME env var with default ~/.lernie/. A small src/harness_root.rs (or similar) that resolves the path once and exposes it to config loaders.
2. Split provider config into two files:
   - Global <harness-root>/providers.yaml: existing 'providers:' (endpoint, auth, adapter override) and 'models:' (model_id, capabilities) blocks. Loaded from harness root.
   - Per-repo providers.yaml: NEW 'roles:' section only — role -> { provider: <name>, model: <model_id> }. Loaded from <conv-repo>/.
3. Update src/config/providers.rs: split the loader into two functions (or one loader that returns two structs), update cross-validation in src/config/cross.rs (role's provider must exist globally; role's model must be in that provider's model list).
4. Update src/config/mod.rs to load both files at the right paths.
5. The provider/model lookup at dispatch-time stays unchanged in shape — it just reads from the merged view.

=== Constraints ===

- During this phase the conversation repo is still rooted wherever lernie new puts it (no relocation yet). LERNIE_HOME just gates global lookups.
- Per-repo providers.yaml in the v0.2 template still contains providers/models blocks; this phase teaches the loader to ignore those if also present at harness root, but does NOT yet remove them from the template (Phase 2 does).
- The current src/template/ embedding ships a per-repo providers.yaml with everything in it. Add a transitional global providers.yaml fixture in tests so the new loader has something to read; do NOT delete the per-repo blocks until Phase 2.

=== Tests ===

- Unit: harness_root resolution honors LERNIE_HOME, falls back to ~/.lernie/, errors on a missing harness-root providers.yaml with a clear message.
- Unit: per-repo loader rejects 'providers:' or 'models:' blocks with a hint pointing to the new shape (warn, not error, this phase — escalate to error in Phase 4).
- Cross-validation: role references undefined provider/model -> error at load.
- Integration: a scratch <harness-root>/providers.yaml + scratch repo with roles: section loads end-to-end.

=== Out of scope ===

- Removing providers/models blocks from the per-repo template (Phase 2).
- Branch/step shape changes (Phase 3+).
- agents.yaml retirement (Phase 4).

=== Gates ===

Tests, docs, alignment per AGENTS.md (handled inline at review time for this ball).
title: Phase 1: harness root + global providers split
